title: restored 18 missing apps and reorganized the registry into 15 categories
summary: migrated claude to direct api. also shipped an obsidian plugin and a tattoo designer. 24 prs merged. keeping the garden tidy

highlights.title: Claude Direct & Caching
highlights.text: Migrated Claude models directly to Anthropic. Prompt caching is now live, making repeated context faster and cheaper. [API Docs](https://enter.pollinations.ai/api/docs)

highlights.title: NPM Package Rename
highlights.text: Packages are now `ompc` and `mcp`. Less typing, plus `claude-fast` is the new default model. [View on NPM](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations_ai/model-context-protocol)

highlights.title: The Garden Organized
highlights.text: Sorted 542 ecosystem apps into 15 categories like "Vibe Coding" and "AI Studio" for better discoverability on the [Main Website](https://hello.pollinations.ai).

highlights.title: Community Tool: fuckits
highlights.text: A new CLI utility that turns natural language descriptions into executable shell scripts. Yes, that is the real name.
